summary: Read-only recon of the generated-note layout in the pi-scholar extension. A materialized section note is written only by note-storage.writeNoteBook (documents() -> studyDocument(renderSection(...))); renderScholarWorkspace deliberately skips scholar-section/book/exam/tutor (obsidian.ts:536). Emission order after the START marker is: section-details JSON block (attachDetails), status callout, chapter link, ## Lesson (each entry prefixed by its own entry-details JSON block), Source references, Recap and pitfalls, Learning record, ## Questions (per-question `> [!question]` callouts with embedded question-details JSON), END marker. The details blocks are position-independent for the readers, but only the text after the single END marker survives a rewrite (note-storage.ts:24-31,156). No test asserts the section-details block position; the tests that pin layout are relative-order and marker-count assertions.

files.description: details()/readDetails()/attachDetails() emit and parse the `> [!info]- Scholar <kind> details` JSON blocks; questionBlock/questionChunks/readQuestions; transcriptBlock/readTranscript; studyDocument/readStudyDocument orchestrate section+tutor notes.

renderSection emits frontmatter, status callout, chapter link, Lesson, Source references, Recap and pitfalls, Learning record, and the renderer-form ## Questions (### headings); supplementalSourceFigureLines emits the Source references record.
renderTutorSession (274-315) shares the same layout shape with Tutor-specific blocks; renderExam/renderExamAnswerKey for exam notes.
renderScholarHome/renderBook/renderChapter for hub notes (no details block except book hub via attachDetails in note-storage.ts:105).
GENERATED_START/END constants (13-14), block/collapsedRecord/statusCallout/frontmatter/generatedDocument emitters, preservedUserContent marker scanner, markdownText escaping.
callout() framing, FEEDBACK_START/END markers, unframeQuestion() that converts the native `> [!question]` frame back to an H3 + one-level-stripped body for parsing.
documents() builds every generated note; writeNoteBook() rewrites section/tutor/exam/book notes in place via preserveTail() (only text after the old END marker survives).
renderScholarWorkspace/writeGeneratedNote/generatedDocument rewrite path for home/chapter/answer-key notes; skips section/book/exam/tutor at line 536.
mutateBook() saves via ports.save (storage.saveBookState -> note-storage.writeNoteBook) then runs ports.project (renderScholarWorkspace).
Pins collapsedRecord framing (66-67), exactly one generated marker per note (87), byte-identical re-render with handwritten tails (84-95), and that refresh never rewrites a section note (98-107).
Pins Learn/Tutor block order from renderSection output (79-99, 104-140) and callout counts.
Reads the real on-disk section note and pins relative order of Lesson/Learning objectives/Questions/latest question details (565-583, 715-723).

architecture: Two distinct writers. (1) Derived-view projection: obsidian.ts:493 renderScholarWorkspace -> writeGeneratedNote (245-282) using common.ts generatedDocument + preservedUserContent, and it explicitly returns early for scholar-book/section/exam/tutor (536) — it only rewrites home, chapter, and answer-key notes. (2) Record writer: every book mutation (book-service.ts:126-185 mutateBook) calls storage.saveBookState -> note-storage.writeNoteBook (109), whose documents() (86-107) renders all materialized section/tutor/exam/book notes and preserveTail() (24-31, applied at 156) re-attaches only the bytes after the old `<!-- scholar:generated:end -->` marker. Section/tutor notes therefore exist in two forms: the renderSection/renderTutorSession output (### Question headings, no details block — what most render tests see) and the on-disk form produced by note-records.studyDocument (144-152), which injects the section/tutor details block immediately after the START marker and replaces the whole `## Questions` region with `> [!question]` callout blocks carrying embedded question-details JSON. Exam notes are analogous via examDocument (173-183); the book hub gets its details via attachDetails at note-storage.ts:105, and the settings catalog at storage.ts:499.
report:
## 1. Emission order of the generated region today

Section note as written to disk (`documents()` note-storage.ts:86-107 -> `studyDocument(renderSection(...), "section", section)` note-storage.ts:94):

1. **frontmatter** — `frontmatter()` render/common.ts:162-168, called at render/section.ts:233-236. Fields: `type: scholar-section`, `book_id`, `chapter_id`, `section_id`, `status`, `current`, `created`, `updated`, then the fixed `cssclasses:`/`tags:` lines. Emitted first by `generatedDocument` (common.ts:170-172) as `header + "\n" + START + "\n" + body`.
2. **`<!-- scholar:generated:start -->`** — common.ts:13 + generatedDocument common.ts:171.
3. **`> [!info]- Scholar section details`** — `details()` note-records.ts:10-12 (via `collapsedRecord` common.ts:59-69), inserted by `attachDetails` note-records.ts:28-30, invoked from `studyDocument` note-records.ts:147. Output shape (`details` joins with `\n`): a leading blank line, the header line, `> ```json`, `> { …json… }` quoted line-per-line, `> ````, trailing blank line. So this block sits *between* the START marker and the status callout.
4. **status callout** — render/section.ts:237-242 via `statusCallout` common.ts:153-160: `> [!scholar-status] <statusLabel>`, `>`, `> Current section · Pages a–b · N short questions remaining`.
5. **chapter link** — render/section.ts:243: `wikiLink(notePath, chapterNotePath(config, book, chapter), chapterLabel)` -> `[[./Chapter …|Chapter N: Title]]` (common.ts:41-43).
6. **`## Lesson`** — render/section.ts:217 via `block("## Lesson", lessonLines)` (common.ts:54-57). `lessonLines` is `transcriptBlock(...)` (note-records.ts:122-131): for each assistant entry, `> [!info]- Scholar entry details` + quoted JSON (details(), note-records.ts:10-12), a blank line, then the entry markdown unquoted, then `<!-- scholar:entry:end -->` (ENTRY_END note-records.ts:9). If no teaching exists, this block is replaced by an honest sentence (render/section.ts:217-219).
7. **`> [!note]- Source references`** — `supplementalSourceFigureLines` render/section.ts:130-138 (collapsedRecord at :137), only when captures are not already embedded in the lesson.
8. **`> [!note]- Recap and pitfalls`** — render/section.ts:221-225, containing `### Section summary`, `### Key points`, `### Common pitfalls`.
9. **`> [!note]- Learning record`** — render/section.ts:226-230, containing `### Learning objectives` (coverage table), `### Understanding checks`, `### Remaining work`.
10. **`## Questions`** — the on-disk form does *not* come from the renderer: `studyDocument` note-records.ts:148 deletes the renderer's `^## Questions` region (regex `/^## Questions\r?\n[\s\S]*?(?=^## |<!-- scholar:generated:end -->)/m`) and note-records.ts:150 re-inserts, immediately before the END marker, `## Questions\n\n` + `questionBlock()` per attempt (note-records.ts:41-58). Each question is a top-level `> [!question] Question N · Kind[ · Practice]` callout containing the prompt, optional `#### Context`/`#### Figure`, `#### Choices`, optional `#### Your answer`/`#### Correct answer`/`#### Feedback`, then either `<!-- scholar:feedback:start -->` + a `> [!success|warning]` callout + `<!-- scholar:feedback:end -->` (callouts.ts:9-10; note-records.ts:52-53) or `*Awaiting response*`/`*Cancelled*`/`*<outcome>*`, and finally the nested `> > [!info]- Scholar question details` block. With zero attempts the region is removed and nothing is re-added (note-records.ts:148-150).
11. **`<!-- scholar:generated:end -->`** — common.ts:14, appended by generatedDocument common.ts:171.

The pure renderer form (what most tests and `renderScholarWorkspace` compute) differs at step 10 only: `assessmentQuestionBlock` render/section.ts:174-176 emits `### Question N · Kind` headings plus `#### Answer N` and open `> [!success|warning]` feedback callouts (questionLines render/section.ts:13-18, attemptAnswerLines render/section.ts:42-56, assessmentRecordLines render/section.ts:164-171).

Tutor notes (renderTutorSession render/assessment.ts:274-315) follow the same shape with: `statusCallout("Tutor", …)` (:311), a fixed policy line (:312), book-home link (:313), `## Lesson` (:295), Source references (:298), `## Visual references` (:299), `> [!note]- Recap` (:300-303), `> [!note]- Practice scope` (:304), `## Questions` (:305, again replaced by questionBlock in `studyDocument` with kind `tutor`). Book hub: `attachDetails(renderBook(...), "book", bookMetadata(book))` note-storage.ts:105 — same post-START position, no Lesson/Questions. Home, chapter, answer-key notes carry no details block.

## 2. Generic projection vs mode-specific renderers, and the details payloads

- **Generic machinery**: common.ts `frontmatter`/`generatedDocument`/`block`/`collapsedRecord`/`statusCallout`/`wikiLink`/`markdownText`; the marker scanner `preservedUserContent` (common.ts:233-...) and `writeGeneratedNote` (obsidian.ts:245-282) used by `renderScholarWorkspace` (obsidian.ts:493). It rewrites only `scholar-home` (obsidian.ts:631), `scholar-chapter` (:640) and `scholar-answer-key` (:662); `scholar-book|section|exam|tutor` are skipped at obsidian.ts:536.
- **Mode-specific renderers**: `renderSection` (render/section.ts:182), `renderTutorSession` (render/assessment.ts:274), `renderExam`/`renderExamAnswerKey` (render/assessment.ts:244/195), `renderBook`/`renderChapter`/`renderScholarHome` (render/navigation.ts:32/72/18).
- **Details injection points**: `studyDocument` (note-records.ts:144-152) for section/tutor; `examDocument` (note-records.ts:173-183) for exams; `attachDetails` for book hub (note-storage.ts:105) and settings catalog (storage.ts:499).
- **Section-details payload** (`studyDocument` destructures `{ attempts, transcript, ...metadata }`, note-records.ts:145; typed at types.ts:163-204): `id, order, number?, title, startPage, endPage, objectives, coveredObjectives, requiredChecks, status, synthesis?, keyPoints, misconceptions, snapshots?, figureCoverage?, lessonCommit?, lessonEntryIds?, legacyLessonCompletion?, objectiveChecks?, learnQuality?, legacyCompletion?, createdAt, updatedAt`. Note that `synthesis`, `keyPoints`, `misconceptions`, `snapshots` and `learnQuality` (review receipts/findings/source coverage) are duplicated here in full — this is the bulky metadata in the reader's path.
- **Entry-details payload** (`transcriptBlock` destructures `{ markdown, ...metadata }`, note-records.ts:125; typed at types.ts:96-103): `id, kind, createdAt, lesson?` (LessonReceipt).
- **Question-details payload** (`questionBlock` destructures `{ question, options, quiz, answerSummary, feedback, correctAnswer, outcome, ...metadata }`, note-records.ts:42; typed at types.ts:65-93): `id, toolCallId?, resumeToolCallIds?, kind, format, mode?, note?, difficulty?, grounding?, openAssessment?, submission?, evaluation?, createdAt`, plus `openFormHash` when `openAssessment` (note-records.ts:55) and, when `quiz`, `quiz` (quiz minus `question`/`context` and with option `label` stripped, note-records.ts:43-45) plus `formHash` and `contextHash` (note-records.ts:55-56).
- Exam-question details are emitted inside `> [!question] Question N` callouts by `examDocument` (note-records.ts:177-182) with `formHash`; exam root details come from `attachDetails(..., "exam", metadata)` (note-records.ts:175).

## 3. Parser contracts in `note-records.ts`

- **`readDetails(text, kind)`** (note-records.ts:14-25): scans the *whole* text with `/^> \[!info\]- Scholar ([\w-]+) details\r?\n((?:>[^\n]*(?:\n|$))*)/gm` (:15), filters `match[1] === kind` (:16). More than one record of the kind throws `Duplicate Scholar <kind> details` (:17); zero returns `undefined` (:18). Body = `records[0][2].replace(/^> ?/gm, "").trim()` (:19), then `/^```json\s*\n([\s\S]*)\n```$/` (:20), then JSON.parse (:23) and a format/kind/data check (:24). Tolerance: position-independent (top, bottom, or between any blocks); any number of unrelated blocks may coexist; body lines must all be quoted (a bare blank/non-quoted line terminates the record, regex `(?:>[^\n]*...)`), CRLF tolerated, header must start at column 0 (`^` + /m). Not tolerated: two blocks of the same kind anywhere in the note; an unclosed/incomplete JSON fence; any non-quoted interruption inside the block.
- **`readTranscript(text)`** (note-records.ts:132-142): `text.split(/(?=^> \[!info\]- Scholar entry details)/m)` (:133); a chunk only counts if `chunk.startsWith("> [!info]- Scholar entry details")` (:135); requires `<!-- scholar:entry:end -->` (:137, constant :9); markdown = chunk minus the header line and its contiguous quoted JSON lines — regex `/^> \[!info\]- Scholar entry details\r?\n(?:>[^\n]*(?:\n|$))*/` (:139) — then `.split(ENTRY_END)[0].trim()`. So the details block must *directly precede* the entry text and be fully quoted; there is no window scanned above a heading — the window is exactly the contiguous quoted lines after the header, terminated by the first unquoted line. An unquoted line before the details header is fine (it just ends the previous chunk).
- **`questionChunks(text)`** (note-records.ts:60-79): line scan with fence tracking (` ````/`~~~`, depth-matched to the current quote depth, :63-72); region opens at `/^## Questions\r?\n/` (:73) and closes at `/^(?:## |<!-- scholar:generated:end -->)/` (:75); a new chunk begins at `/^(?:### |\> \[!question\] )Question \d+\b/` (:76) — i.e. both the legacy `### Question N` heading and the current `> [!question] Question N` frame, nothing else, at column 0. So the region is bounded by `## Questions` and the next `##` heading or the END marker; arbitrary extra blocks inside the region are tolerated except lines that look like `## `/a question start, and fences protect those literals.
- **`questionText`** (note-records.ts:81-82) truncates at the first `^#### `, `^> \[!info\]- Scholar `, or a status line (`*Awaiting response|Cancelled|pending|pass|review|unsure|unavailable*`). **`readField`** (:35-38) uses the same stop set, so a details block placed after a field never leaks into that field.
- **`readStudyDocument`** (note-records.ts:154-157) requires the section/tutor details block and throws `Missing Scholar <kind> details; the note will not be rebuilt from history.` (no history fallback).
- **`migrateVisibleTeaching`** (note-records.ts:220-223) extracts `## Lesson` up to `^## (Source figures|Visual references|Questions)$`, a `> [!…]- (Recap|Recap and pitfalls|Learning record|Practice scope)` callout, or END — i.e. the admin callouts are recognized by those exact titles.

## 4. Regeneration entry points

- **In-place rewrite of existing section notes**: `writeNoteBook(config, book, expectedRevision?, migration = false)` — note-storage.ts:109. `documents()` (:86-107) renders every materialized section/tutor/exam plus the book hub; per-file diff at :147-158; the surviving reader bytes come from `preserveTail(generated, previous)` (:156), which keeps only `previous.slice(index + GENERATED_END.length)` (:27) and throws if the previous note does not contain exactly one END marker (:26). Writes are atomic and roll back only Scholar's own bytes (:164-175).
- **Handwritten content**: only text *after* the single `<!-- scholar:generated:end -->` survives (`preserveTail`); edits above START or anywhere inside the generated region — including the details blocks, the status callout, and the Lesson/Questions bodies — are overwritten on the next `writeNoteBook`. (The weaker `preservedUserContent`/`writeGeneratedNote` path, common.ts:233 / obsidian.ts:245, applies only to home/chapter/answer-key notes and migrations.)
- **How it is invoked**: every mutation through `book-service.ts:126-185 mutateBook` calls `ports.save` (= `saveBookState`, storage.ts:480-483 -> `writeNoteBook`) and then `ports.project` (= `renderScholarWorkspace`; wiring at runtime-coordinator.ts:203-228). The scholar tool actions call `mutateBook` (tool-actions/learning.ts:47-115 `handleNotes`, :271-… `handleAssess`). There is no maintenance command; README:416 states derived views refresh after saves.
- **Headless, one section**: there is no public per-section regenerate function (`documents()` is module-private and `renderScholarWorkspace` skips section notes at obsidian.ts:536). The nearest exact call is: `const book = await storage.loadBookState(config, bookId); await storage.saveBookState(config, book, book.revision)` (storage.ts:485 / :480) or directly `note-storage.writeNoteBook(config, book, book.revision)` (note-storage.ts:109) after `readNoteBook`/`loadBookState`. That recomputes every materialized section note and writes only files whose bytes changed; calling it with `expectedRevision === undefined` throws when the book note already exists (note-storage.ts:121-122). Tests drive exactly this path (e.g. verify-scholar-projection.mjs:102 uses renderScholarWorkspace, but storage.saveBookState is used across save-sync/history verifiers).

## 5. Tests pinning layout order, and the bottom-appendix question

- `tests/verify-scholar-projection.mjs:66-67` — `collapsedRecord("Empty", [""]) === []` and the exact joined shape `"\n> [!abstract]- Record\n> body\n>\n>     code\n"`. This pins the blank-line framing every details block inherits (details() -> collapsedRecord). A new emitter that produces different framing fails here.
- `tests/verify-scholar-projection.mjs:87` — exactly one `<!-- scholar:generated:start -->` per written note; `:84-95` — 7 notes, appended reader tails, then two further projections byte-identical; `:98-107` — an edit inside the generated region of a section note survives `renderScholarWorkspace` (because section notes are skipped at obsidian.ts:536) and a deleted section note is not recreated.
- `tests/verify-scholar-note-design.mjs:74-76` — one START and one END per note, no H1/placeholder text.
- `tests/verify-scholar-note-design.mjs:81-83` — strict increasing order of `"## Lesson" < synthesis < longExplanation < "> [!note]- Source references" < "> [!note]- Recap and pitfalls" < "> ### Key points" < "> ### Common pitfalls" < "> [!note]- Learning record" < "> ### Learning objectives" < "> ### Understanding checks" < "## Questions" < "### Question 1" < … < "*Awaiting response*"` on `renderSection` output. `:105-139` filters `marked` blockquotes by excluding `[!info]- Scholar entry details`, then asserts `parsed.length === 2 + (hasHistory ? 2 : 0)` (:115), that `parsed[0]` is `[!note]- Recap and pitfalls` and `parsed[1]` is `[!note]- Learning record` (:117-118), and in the figures fixture `callouts(figuresNote).length === 4` with indices 0/1 = Source references / Learning record (:134-136).
- `tests/verify-scholar-note-design.mjs:150-151` — the same strict order for Tutor (`[!note]- Recap`, `[!note]- Practice scope`).
- `tests/verify-scholar-ui-contract.mjs:565-583` — on the real on-disk section note: `## Lesson` index < `> ### Learning objectives` index < `## Questions` index < the latest `> [!question] Question 2` index, and `/^> > \[!info\]- Scholar question details/m` must match inside the slice from that question onward (:578). `:717-723` — `## Questions` after `## Lesson`, answers after the last question, question details between `## Questions` and the END index.
- `tests/verify-scholar-projection.mjs:139` and `verify-scholar-note-design.mjs:139` — `Source references` index < `## Questions` index.
- `tests/verify-scholar-*` round-trip verifiers (callout-boundaries.mjs:35-37, 50-54; note-authority.mjs:117-137; presentation.mjs:60-68) exercise `questionChunks`/`readQuestions`/`readDetails` on constructed notes, i.e. they pin the parser tolerances, not the emitter position.

**If the section-details block moves to a bottom appendix** (still inside the generated region): all of the above index/order assertions are *relative* and would still pass, and `readDetails` is position-independent — except for two concrete hazards. (a) If it is placed after the last `> [!question]` block but before END, `questionChunks` will append it to the final question chunk; `questionText`/`readField` stop at `^> \[!info\]- Scholar ` so parsing survives, but the round-trip equality assertions built from that chunk (callout-boundaries.mjs:36-37, presentation.mjs:60-63) become position-sensitive. (b) If instead the block is emitted *after* `<!-- scholar:generated:end -->`, `preserveTail` re-attaches it as reader tail on every `writeNoteBook` and the next render would produce a second copy — `readDetails` then throws `Duplicate Scholar section details`, and `verify-scholar-projection.mjs:87-95` (one marker + byte-identical re-render) would fail. Conversely, if the block is moved out of `studyDocument`/`attachDetails` and into `renderSection` itself (a likely shape for task 3), `verify-scholar-note-design.mjs:115` and `:134` would fail: their callout filters exclude only `[!info]- Scholar entry details`, so a top-level `> [!info]- Scholar section details` block adds one to every count. No test today asserts the details block's absolute position or its presence in a section note; `readDetails`'s own tolerance means placement is free architecturally, but the writer's tail contract (note-storage.ts:24-31) and those two counts are the binding constraints.
